notes.title: Dead Sale Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Version: V 1.0.1

[b] Bug Fixes & Improvements:[/b]

-Fixed barricaded door message: The "This door is barricaded" message will now only appear when the player can actually see the wooden planks blocking it.
-Collision adjustments: Optimized object collisions, with special focus on doors and stairs, to improve movement fluidity.
-Restricted access to empty containers: Players can no longer interact with drawers or doors that contain no items.
-Fixed settings location issue: Resolved a problem where game settings were not being saved in the correct location.
-Interaction prompt improvement: The word "Interaction" has been replaced with the specific key the player needs to press, improving clarity and usability.
-Repositioned notes: Adjusted the placement of certain notes that were hard to see due to lighting conditions.

[b]Additional Fixes:[/b]

-Fixed second-floor collision issue: Resolved a bug that allowed players to access the second floor while it was still blocked.
-Staircase collision rework: Improved staircase collision to prevent enemies from getting stuck while going up or down.
-Fixed doorframe collisions: Adjusted doorframe collisions so the character can pass through smoothly.
-Enhanced interaction prompts: Interaction messages now display the correct key that needs to be pressed.
-Reorganized language settings: The language settings have been moved to a separate screen for better menu organization.

Thank you for your feedback! We’re continuously working to improve the game experience. 🚀
